- Standard Redwood Hosted SLA; no additional custom SRE commitments beyond priority on call.

Why this makes sense:
- Forecasted revenue with the commitment and expected expansion across three hospitals gives a 36‑month LTV that exceeds our baseline threshold for strategic healthcare verticals.
- SummitCare brings potentially strong public references in the northeast region and a fast ramp (pilot to production in 3–4 months).
- They are flexible on payment cadence (quarterly invoicing) and accept a 45‑day payment term.

Attachments: SummitCare_MA-usage_forecast.xlsx, Redwood-Proposal-v3.pdf, contract_redlines.docx

Customer asks/legal: SummitCare legal has a small set of redlines around data residency and audit rights — they are in the attached doc. They do not require on‑prem, only US‑based region hosting.

If approved, the ask is for Marcus / Ben to sign off by end of day Wednesday so we can send the DocuSign and start the onboarding window.
